narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000006 — THE NEON THUNDERDOME

A crackling octagon of light where every answer echoes off the dome.

Tonight the dome hosts Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper (hybrid) against Smoker Guide x Journal Prompter (hybrid). Judging: The Sprinter's Rubric. The mission: "Explain why the sky is blue using only food metaphors." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper steadies a shield-wall of facts (76 pts). Smoker Guide x Journal Prompter presses the attack a surge of structured thought (59.8 pts). Round to Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper.

ROUND 2: Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper opens a shield-wall of facts (72.7 pts). Smoker Guide x Journal Prompter weaves a cascade of examples (49.9 pts). Round to Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper.

ROUND 3: Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper ripples a precision strike of clarity (80.6 pts). Smoker Guide x Journal Prompter presses the attack a lightning analogy (52.5 pts). Round to Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper.

FINAL: Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper defeats Smoker Guide x Journal Prompter, 229.3 to 162.2 — a margin of 67.1 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Accuracy. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

Strongest dimension: Accuracy — Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper's accuracy carried all three rounds.
Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.

Hybrid vigor confirmed: the fused lineage (Mix-and-match hybrid of Tea Steeper (JAH-AI-DOM-224) and Flight Delay Helper (JAH-AI-DOM-206). Shared record with the AI Mix Lab.) outperformed both parent archetypes tonight.
Rematch recommendation: run Smoker Guide x Journal Prompter against a pure system contender to isolate the accuracy gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sprinter's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Speed 35%, Conciseness 30%, Accuracy 20%, Confidence 15%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000006, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper's accuracy-first drill for "Explain why the sky is blue using only foo"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on accuracy when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Tea Steeper x Flight Delay Helper's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000006: isolate accuracy, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
